author: casarsa
body:
#### PR description:

This PR updates the BTL time-walk corrections and the RecHit time-error parameterization, and adds the tools used to derive them. It also includes a fix by @martinamalberti to the BTL RecHit energy in the aging scenarios (e5cd2bc, which sets npeSaturationCorrection in aging.py).

BTL local reconstruction:
  - mtdUncalibratedRecHits_cfi.py, aging.py (0, 1000 and 3000 fb), and hltMtdUncalibratedRecHits_cfi.py:
    - The time-walk correction is now a shifted power law plus a constant, a*(x+b)^c + d.
    - The time resolution is now sqrt((p0/x) + p1/x + p2).
    - The HLT copy is aligned with the offline one.
  - BTLUncalibRecHitAlgo: ADC and TDC saturation of each channel is flagged in the flags word. Bits 4 and 5 are the right ADC and TDC, and bits 6 and 7 are the left ADC and TDC.

BtlLocalRecoValidation:
  - New FillTimeWalkPlots flag (default False) that fills profiles of T_RECO  T_SIM vs hit energy (DeltaTsimvsE, _R, _L), skipping saturated channels.
  - Energy range extended (nBinsQ 3044, one extra eta-Q bin).
  - New macro fitBTLTimeWalkCorr.C fits the DeltaTsimvsE profile. makeTimeResPlots.C is synced with the new binning.


#### PR validation:

Tested with workflow 34434.0 (TTbar 14 TeV, Run4D121, 10 events) for aging 0, 1000 and 3000 fb, comparing the plain CMSSW_20_1_0_pre3 release with this branch.

The PR affects only the BTL step3.
The estimated step 3 performance for a single thread process is:
